entities.summary: André Routis was a French professional boxer. He fought 86 times between 1919 and 1929; winning 54, losing 25 and drawing 7. After a victory over Tony Canzoneri he held the Undisputed Featherweight title from 1928 to 1929. Earlier in his career Routis competed as a bantamweight, where he won the French title and fought three times for the EBU title. Before turning professional Routis won the French amateur bantamweight championship in 1918.
